name: manual_72c5de
claim: After context compaction, browser refresh, or a long-conversation reset, resume from committed working-memory records and live Git state before relying on an older surviving chat exchange.

decisions.notes: A user reported that a web Codex counterpart reverted to its last recorded thread after the chat became too long. Committed continuity records plus branch verification prevent repeated questions and stale assumptions.
